title: Millionaire's Row Segway Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore Miami's Glamorous Sights!** Discover Miami Beach in a unique way with our **Millionaire's Row Segway Tour**! Start by gliding through the iconic **Art Deco District**, admiring the colorful, historic architecture that defines the city’s charm. As you continue along the scenic waterfront, take in stunning views of Biscayne Bay and the bustling marina. The tour’s highlight is **Millionaire's Row**, where you'll see the extravagant mansions and estates of Miami’s elite. Our knowledgeable guide will share captivating stories about the celebrities and history behind these luxurious homes. This engaging and fun tour offers a fantastic way to experience the elegance and excitement of Miami Beach. Don’t miss out on this unforgettable adventure—book your Segway tour today!
